examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to recognise; to find out', paired with 'узнавать'.

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.
You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.

examples.text: Не волнуйся ты насчёт этого Мишкина.
examples.trans: Don't you worry about that Mishkin.

examples.text: Не волнуйся ты насчёт этого Мишкина. Работаем мы с ним.
examples.trans: Don't you worry about that Mishkin. We're working on him.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'арок'). Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'present, gift' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is a present for you.

examples.text: Это семейный праздник. Как в детстве, с подарками!
examples.trans: It's a family holiday. Like when we were kids, with presents!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to be liked, to make a good impression
meanings.note: person who likes is in the dative

examples.text: Синеозерск понравился в Москве больше других мест.
examples.trans: In Moscow they liked Sineozersk more than other places.
Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('beautiful, handsome').

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.
Watch. I'm taking off my ring.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: А зачем? Я сам сделал так, чтобы он его написал.
examples.trans: And why would I? I'm the one who made him write it.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order
the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: я считаю, что... = I think that...

examples.text: Эх, Паша, Паша. Ты считать не умеешь.
examples.trans: Oh, Pasha, Pasha. You can't count.
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: выбирать слова = to choose one's words

examples.trans: He takes a long time choosing a new dish.

examples.text: Выбирай слова, когда говоришь с ней!
examples.trans: Choose your words when talking with her!

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.en: to send (something or someone to the speaker)
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'слать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to send (here)', paired with 'присылать'.

examples.trans: They sent me a free lawyer.

examples.text: Послушайте, здесь ошибка. Ко мне прислали бесплатного адвоката. В чём дело?
examples.trans: Listen, there's a mistake here. They sent me a free lawyer. What's going on?

meanings.note: Classical Greek compound borrowing ('фотография'), feminine noun. Common feminine noun meaning 'photograph, photo' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: А можно с вами фотографию, пожалуйста?
examples.trans: May I take a photo with you, please?

examples.text: Давайте быстрее! А можно с вами фотографию, пожалуйста?
examples.trans: Hurry up! May I take a photo with you, please?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'арить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to give (as a present)', paired with 'дарить'.

examples.text: А вы мне тоже айфон подарите?
examples.trans: Will you give me an iPhone too?

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'резать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'cut off, clip'.

examples.text: Это слово «подрезать» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'cut off' is often heard in conversation.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.
Agreed, I will choose a movie.

meanings.note: я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.
Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to buy', paired with 'покупать'.

examples.text: Юле бы дублёнку купили, Славику бы ноутбук.
examples.trans: We could have bought Yulia a sheepskin coat, and Slavik a laptop.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.
